end.summary:
Practised reading and writing numerals 1–9 and zero.
Matched numerals to groups of the same quantity: 2 unaided correct attempts out of 2.
Wrote 3 for three and identified a group of three birds.
Counted birds decreasing from three to two to one; explored zero and the meaning of “minus.”
Used claps and fingers to represent four and eight.
end.parentNote: Asha practised matching numerals with groups, writing 3 for three, and representing numbers with claps and fingers. Aarav used counting to explain that three birds becoming two and then one leaves one; they also asked about zero, “minus,” and a scoreboard. The scoreboard/minus mix-up was explored through the bird-counting example, but a full teach-back was not yet passed. At home, show small groups of 0–9 objects and ask Aarav to count them, say the numeral, and write it.
